food_waste.title: Food waste
food_waste.hero_text: Wasted food means wasted resources and higher emissions. Small changes at home make a real difference.
food_waste.fact_1_label: of food is wasted globally each year
food_waste.fact_2_label: average annual cost of wasted food per household
food_waste.fact_3_label: of freshwater used for food ends up wasted
food_waste.fact_4_label: of global emissions come from food waste
food_waste.why_text: Food waste uses land, water, and energy to produce food that never gets eaten. It also adds methane emissions when it breaks down.
food_waste.household_text: Most food waste happens at home due to overbuying, forgotten leftovers, and unclear expiry dates.
food_waste.how_text: Plan meals, track what you have, and use items before they expire. A quick scan helps keep your inventory accurate.
food_waste.tip_1: Shop with a list and check your pantry first.
food_waste.tip_2: Store food properly so it lasts longer.
food_waste.tip_3: Freeze extra portions before they spoil.
food_waste.tip_4: Use leftovers in new meals and snacks.
food_waste.app_text: FreshTrack highlights what is expiring soon, suggests recipes, and helps your household stay organized so less food goes to waste.
